source: sandbox-ai's local-model research of 2026-11-15/16: LM Studio (MLX and llama.cpp runtimes) on an Apple-silicon Mac, nine harnesses, a smoke test (start, the harness's own tool, an MCP tool, an edit) and harder tasks (a debugging task with two root causes and a 2 MB log, an MCP-heavy task, a web task, ten dependent turns). Phase 2: mostly single runs through the research's own relay; round 1: four models on every harness through sandbox-ai's own proxy and MCP relay, two or more runs per pair. docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md has the details. Round 4 (2026-11-17/18): eight new models, two runs per pair.
